servers.name: Microsoft Sentinel
servers.purpose: Incident and analytics rule management for Microsoft Sentinel

tools.name: sentinel_list_incidents
tools.description: List recent Sentinel incidents with severity, status, and alert count

parameters.top: Maximum number of incidents to return (default: 20)

tools.name: sentinel_get_incident
tools.description: Get full details of a specific Sentinel incident by ID

tools.name: sentinel_get_incident_alerts
tools.description: Get all alerts associated with a specific incident

parameters.incidentId: The incident ID to get alerts for

tools.name: sentinel_get_incident_entities
tools.description: Get all entities (IPs, users, hosts, files) associated with an incident

parameters.incidentId: The incident ID to get entities for

tools.name: sentinel_list_analytics_rules
tools.description: List all active Sentinel analytics rules with their MITRE mappings

tools.name: sentinel_get_analytics_rule
tools.description: Get details of a specific analytics rule including KQL query and MITRE tactics/techniques

parameters.ruleId: The analytics rule ID to retrieve

servers.name: Log Analytics
servers.purpose: KQL query execution against the Log Analytics workspace

tools.name: loganalytics_execute_query
tools.description: Execute a KQL query against the Log Analytics workspace and return results

tools.name: loganalytics_list_tables
tools.description: List all available tables in the Log Analytics workspace

tools.name: loganalytics_get_table_schema
tools.description: Get the schema (columns, types) for a specific Log Analytics table

parameters.tableName: The table name to get schema for

servers.name: Threat Intelligence
servers.purpose: IoC lookups and enrichment against threat intelligence sources

tools.name: ti_lookup_ip
tools.description: Look up an IP address against threat intelligence sources and return reputation, geolocation, and associated threats

parameters.ipAddress: The IP address to look up

tools.name: ti_lookup_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain name against threat intelligence sources and return reputation and associated threats

parameters.domain: The domain name to look up

tools.name: ti_lookup_file_hash
tools.description: Look up a file hash (MD5, SHA1, SHA256) against threat intelligence sources

parameters.hash: The file hash to look up
parameters.hashType: Hash type: md5, sha1, or sha256

tools.name: ti_lookup_url
tools.description: Look up a URL against threat intelligence sources and return reputation and scan results

tools.name: ti_search_indicators
tools.description: Search Sentinel ThreatIntelligenceIndicator table for matching indicators

parameters.value: The indicator value to search for
parameters.type: Optional indicator type filter: ipv4, domain, url, file

servers.name: Security Copilot
servers.purpose: AI-assisted security analysis and summarization via Microsoft Security Copilot

tools.name: seccopilot_analyze_incident
tools.description: Use Security Copilot to provide AI-assisted analysis of a Sentinel incident

parameters.incidentId: The Sentinel incident ID to analyze

tools.name: seccopilot_generate_summary
tools.description: Use Security Copilot to generate a natural language summary of security findings

parameters.context: The security data or findings to summarize

tools.name: seccopilot_suggest_queries
tools.description: Use Security Copilot to suggest KQL queries for further investigation
